title: PoluFlat
description: A small resource pack that changes the basic UI/GUI elements to a minimalistic dark interface
body:

# Description
A small resource pack that changes the main interface elements to a minimalistic dark version. This RP replaces the containers of various blocks, the player's inventory tabs, and various small items.

This is most likely not the final version of the resource pack, and we also plan to add support for some popular mods.
